name: Mossmutter
title: Mossmutter, the Fungal False Keraptis
cond_immunes: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
senses: blindsight 120 ft., telepathy 120 ft. (speaks only through Saprophis or Skin Puppets), passive Perception 13

Traits: Innate Spellcasting

Spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks. At will: ray of frost (3d8), entangle, fog cloud. 3/day each: cone of cold, ice storm, cloudkill, blight. 1/day each: death fog, freezing sphere, wall of ice.
Hive Mind
Sees and hears through every Skin Puppet. Attacking any puppet ring alerts him.
Bloodied: Fungal Shell
At 115 HP or fewer, once, he hardens his bark (+4 AC) and orders all Skin Puppets to swarm the attackers.
Actions: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage. An ice shard embeds in the target: at the start of each of its turns it loses 1d4 Strength and takes 5 damage (Mossmutter gains the same as temporary hit points). A creature can use an action to make a DC 16 Constitution save or Medicine check to extract it.
30-foot cone. DC 17 Constitution save or take 18 (4d8) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute.
Legendary Actions: Costs 1 action: makes a Tendril Lash attack.
Costs 2 actions: 60-foot line of subzero rime. Each creature in the line makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) cold damage on a failure, half on a success.

Traits: Gnome Cunning
Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic.
Toe-Ring of Spell Turning
Advantage on saves against spells. Once per day, reflects one spell of 5th level or lower back at its caster.
Brother's Doubt
If the party mentions Thallo or casts dispel magic while he is bloodied (56 HP or fewer), he may falter, questioning Mossmutter's orders.
Actions: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Reactions: When a creature within reach makes an opportunity attack or leaves his reach, he makes a halberd attack; on a hit the target's speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

Traits: Hive Voice
Any puppet can relay Mossmutter's telepathic speech. Dormant puppets resemble bulbous polyps (DC 15 Perception to spot at 50 ft).
Collapse
When it dies, its skin splits into 15-HP mold wyrm gel that revives after 8 hours.
Actions: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage and coughs: -2 to attack rolls, saves, and checks until the end of its next turn.

name: Slug of Remarkable Size
title: Slug of Remarkable Size
senses: blindsight 100 ft. (vibration and scent), passive Perception 8

Traits: Docile Grazer
Ignores creatures that don't attack it. Charm effects (e.g., animal friendship, DC 14) make it an ally or diversion.
Slime Trail
Its slime leaves difficult terrain behind it for 10 minutes.
Actions: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.

name: Burning Golem
title: Burning Golem
immunes: fire, poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
cond_immunes: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Traits: Clinging Cinders
A creature hit by a cinder fist catches fire, taking 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until someone takes an action to douse the fire with water or loose earth.
Quench Vulnerability
If subjected to cold damage or at least 10 gallons of water, the golem's AC drops to 14 and its Clinging Cinders trait is suppressed for 1 round.
Immutable Form
The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
Magic Resistance
The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons
The golem's weapon attacks are magical.
Thermal Meltdown (Bloodied Rally)
If the golem rallies when bloodied (66 HP or fewer), upon death it explodes in a 10-foot burst of burning cinders (10 (3d6) fire damage, DC 14 Dexterity save for half).
Actions: The golem makes two Cinder Fist attacks.

Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage, and the target catches fire, taking 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each turn until doused with water or loose earth (action).
The golem emits an unearthly wail. Each creature within 60 ft. must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute (save ends at end of each turn).

Traits: Human Disguise
Appears as a bald, tattooed human scholar until he drops the illusion to reveal his efreeti form.
Innate Spellcasting

Spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks. At will: detect magic, fire bolt (3d10), misty step. 3/day each: scorching ray, shield, counterspell, invisibility. 1/day each: fireball (8d6), wall of fire, polymorph, conjure elemental (fire), cone of cold.
Bloodied Morale
At 75 HP or fewer he may rally, flee invisible, bargain (offering the Area 59 lab combination), or surrender.
Actions: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

name: Bloodwight
title: Bloodwight
resists: fire, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks
cond_immunes: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond), blood sense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

Traits: Blood Sense
Pinpoints creatures with blood within 60 ft.
Regeneration
Regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.
Purification Vulnerability

If targeted by purify food and drink, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or take 27 (6d8) radiant damage and have its regeneration halted for 1 minute. Cold damage reduces its speed by 10 feet.
Actions: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage as the target's blood expels through its skin. The bloodwight regains hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

name: Mold Wyrm
title: Mold Wyrm
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond), tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

Traits: Spore Aura
Any creature starting its turn within 10 feet of the wyrm must make a DC 15 Constitution save or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute.
Actions: One Bite and one Tail Slam.

Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained.
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

30-foot cone of corrosive mold. Each creature in the area makes a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 36 (8d6) necrotic damage and becoming blinded for 1 minute on a failure, or half damage and not blinded on a success.

name: Aegwareth
title: Aegwareth
meta: Medium Undead/Celestial (Elder Druid Shade), Neutral Good
resists: acid, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
cond_immunes: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone

Traits: Incorporeal Movement
Can move through other creatures and objects as difficult terrain.
Actions: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or magically age 1d10 + 4 years.
If he realizes he cannot prevent Keraptis's escape or achieve his revenge, Aegwareth calls the colossal Magma Leviathan from the lava sea to crush the crystal Fane, sacrificing his own existence.
Bonus Actions: Becomes nearly transparent. While obscure he is invulnerable to all damage and regenerates 10 hit points at the start of his turn, but cannot make physical attacks.

name: Keraptis
title: Keraptis
meta: Medium Humanoid (Human Wizard / Shadow-Transcended Archmage), Neutral Evil
resists: cold, fire, lightning, psychic; damage from spells

Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
If Keraptis fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance
Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Master of the Four Pillars

Keraptis forged the planar bindings on Wave, Whelm, Blackrazor, and Frostrazor. His soul cannot be devoured by Blackrazor, and he ignores the necrotic/cold immunity-bypassing traits of his own bound weapons unless he is bloodied (123 HP or fewer).
Living K-Imprint Aura

Any creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of Keraptis hears "I am Keraptis" inside its skull and must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom save or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and have disadvantage on concentration saves until the start of its next turn.
Actions: Casts one spell (or cantrip) and makes two Void-Shard Bolt attacks.
Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) force damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

20th-level wizard, Int 22, spell save DC 20, +12 to hit. At will: counterspell (3rd level), dispel magic, fireball, lightning bolt, magic missile (5th level), misty step, shield, wall of force. 3/day each: chain lightning, cone of cold, dimension door, globe of invulnerability, reverse gravity, synaptic static. 1/day each: maze, meteor swarm (or prismatic spray), power word stun, time stop.
Reactions: Casts shield (+5 AC) or counterspell against an enemy spell.

When a creature wielding Wave, Whelm, Blackrazor, or Frostrazor attacks Keraptis, the wielder must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma save or the attack is redirected against another creature of his choice within the weapon's reach.
Legendary Actions: One creature within 120 ft.: +12 to hit, 16 (3d6 + 6) psychic damage.
Teleports up to 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
One of the four weapons within 120 ft. surges: the wielder and each creature within 10 ft. make a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 22 (5d8) damage on a failure, half on a success.
